verdict.rationale: Batch job submissions can register `notifications.webhook_url` with a secret, and Zoom sends an outbound POST when the job finishes. Each request carries an HMAC-SHA256 `x-zm-signature` and a timestamp, and the docs give verification guidance, so callers need not poll the status endpoint. Terminal states are documented (SUCCEEDED, PARTIAL, FAILED, CANCELED), but the docs only say the webhook fires 'when the job finishes', so firing on failure is implied rather than stated. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation the webhook fires on FAILED/PARTIAL outcomes, documented payload schema and retry/delivery guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
